description: A multicolored Rubik’s cube sits on a green tabletop in front of you, with white boards leaning in the background. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand from the right to grasp the cube as a two-hand object, then both hands lift and repeatedly twist different faces—alternating small quarter-turn rotations while repositioning their grips—before briefly easing their hold while keeping the cube near the center of the table.
